title: Pick per role: a timed work sample, or a capped take-home
takeaway: Most roles are best served by a short work sample; a take-home earns its cost only when independent structure is the job.
sources: Screening at volume, or junior roles: work sample, timed, auto-checked where possible.
Senior roles where independent structure is the job: a short, capped take-home plus a conversation about it.
Never both as hard gates in the same loop.
They filter for free time, not skill.

data.question: What does this role need you to see?

branches.answer: Screening at volume, or a junior role
branches.then: Same task and scoring, under an hour

branches.answer: Senior, independent structure is the job
branches.then: Capped scope, rubric, paid past 2 hours
Never both as hard gates in one loop
